title: Integrality of a planar weak limit of integer multiplicity cycles (printed (8)–(10))
statement: Assume SlicingTheorem, LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity, and the statements (exact frozen Lean types) of iwl_restriction_weak_limit, iwl_smooth_pushforward and iwl_top_dim_integrality. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m+1, τ : Fin n → ℝ^P orthonormal, Q := span τ, and c ∈ ℝ. Let Y_k ∈ D_n(ℝ^P) (k ∈ ℕ) be integer multiplicity with ∂Y_k = 0 and sup_k M_{B_2(0)}(Y_k) < ∞, such that Y_k(ω) → c∫_Q ω(z)(τ_1,…,τ_n) dHⁿ(z) (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) for every ω ∈ D^n(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_2(0). Then c ∈ ℤ.
